source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
During [your opponent's Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), in its [Battle-shock step](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock-step), each enemy unit below its [Starting Strength](vsdata:core-rule/units-and-models) that is up to 12" from any of your **HERETIC ASTARTES** units has to make a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock), with -1 to the result. An enemy unit this Detachment rule affects need not make another Battle-shock test that phase.

Whenever a **HERETIC ASTARTES** model of yours attacks a **Below Half-strength** unit, the attack gets +1 to [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls).

Whenever a [Battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock) model attacks one of your **HERETIC ASTARTES** units, the attack gets -1 to Hit.

Whenever a **HERETIC ASTARTES** model of yours attacks a Battle-shocked unit, the attack gets +1 to [Wound](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls).
